Verolite

Multiwall Polycarbonate Panels

Verolite Lexan Multiwall Polycarbonate Panels are a versatile material that is commonly used in various exterior roof and wall applications. It offers several advantages over traditional materials. Their ability to provide a combination of outstanding strength, proper light transmission, and thermal insulation makes them an attractive option for any project.

High Light Transmission
(8mm Clear: 81%)
Multiwall panels allow a high degree of light transmittance, providing ample natural light inside the structure while blocking out harmful UV rays. Other colours are available with varying light transmittance to suit your needs.

Impact Strength
Multiwall polycarbonate panels provide excellent impact strength and stiffness, making them durable enough to withstand extreme weather and external forces.

Thermal Insulation
The cellular structure of multiwall polycarbonate panels enables them to trap air within their flutes, providing excellent thermal insulation properties.

Condensation Control
An anti-condensate / anti-fog coating is applied to the panel, preventing moisture buildup and eliminating potential water damage.

Durable and Lightweight
Multiwall polycarbonate panels are 200x stronger than glass! Despite being lightweight, they are almost unbreakable and easy to handle on-site.

Applications

Verolite Multiwall panels are available in a variety of colours and thicknesses, perfect for greenhouse structures and daylighting applications where high light transmission is required in a lightweight sheet. Easy to cut and install, Verolite Multiwall sheets will live up to your expectations season after season.

  • Greenhouses
  • Office Partitions
  • Shelters
  • Canopies
  • Pool Enclosures
  • Walkways
  • Window Replacement
  • Skylights & Sidelites
  • Carports
  • Cold Frames
  • Garden Centers
  • Sheds
  • Patio Covering
  • Sunrooms
  • Printed Wall Art

*Other colours and sizes are available upon special request. Extended lead times may apply.

Specifications

• Panel Lengths: 10′, 12′, 16′
• Panel Thickness: 8mm
• Panel Width: 48″
• Panel Colour: Clear
• Panel Weight: 0.31/sq. ft.
• H Trim Length: 12′ & 16′, U Trim Length: 12′
• High Light Transmission: (8mm Clear: 81%)
